messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v0.9.3 to prod-east1. Starting post-deploy smoke suite: synth-heartbeat, kv-prefill, embed-route-check, tokenizer-sanity. Summary: 31/34 checks OK, 3 warnings. :white_check_mark:

sandeep: saw the alert — embed-route-check p95 spiked to 1.9s in eu3, baseline ~0.6s. Any early idea?

maria: looks like the embed workers in eu3 had increased GC under the new quant config. I can pull metrics.

alex: can you paste the synth probe snippet?

maria: sure — snippet from smoke job:
```json
{"probe":"embed-route-check","region":"eu3","p50_ms":120,"p95_ms":1900,"errors":{"5xx":12,"timeout":3}}
```

jamie: thanks. routing-policy shows a small spike of retries too. Not widespread yet but correlated with the quant2 variant rollout for embed.

liz-oncall: @sandeep @maria @jamie we should contain to limit customer impact. Proposal: quarantine embed-route in eu3 (route all embed traffic to previous model-variant) and keep other routes live. No full rollback. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sandeep: agree. containment first. Can we flip model-variant for embed-route via routing API without touching host infra?

alex: yes — patch traffic-routing: set route /v1/embed -> model: open-embed-v1 (weight 100) in eu3. I can stage the change.

maria: once you flip, I'll re-run the synth probe and watch KV warmup and GC.

deploy-bot: Routing change queued by alex, change-id rc-9834. Applying to prod-east1/eu3 now.

deploy-bot: Routing change rc-9834 applied successfully. Previous model-variant (open-embed-v1) now 100% for /v1/embed in eu3.

maria: re-ran synth — p95 back to 620ms, 5xx -> 1. Still above baseline but much better.

jamie: good containment. We should note in release notes and schedule a follow-up to revisit quant2 allocation for embed in eu3.

liz-oncall: I'll file a quick incident-lite so ops + platform + infra can triage tomorrow. Tagging runbook: embed-route-quarantine.

sandeep: decision summary: partial route quarantine applied in eu3 for embed-route (model reverted to open-embed-v1). No service-wide rollback. Follow-up: ML team to investigate quant2 memory/G1 settings, infra to check host GC flags.

alex: pushing a short release note update -> https://redwood.internal/releases/0.9.3/notes (edited).

jamie: thanks all. marking thread resolved once incident-lite created. :white_check_mark:
